apps.name: Open WebUI
apps.description: ChatGPT-style UI for your local Ollama and llama.cpp models (RAG, users, voice).
apps.compose:
services:
  open-webui:
    image: ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main
    restart: unless-stopped
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      PORT: ${APP_PORT}
      OLLAMA_BASE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:11434
      OPENAI_API_BASE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1
      OPENAI_API_KEY: none
      WEBUI_SECRET_KEY: ${WEBUI_SECRET_KEY}
      TZ: ${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/data:/app/backend/data
apps.notes: Uses host networking so it can reach Ollama (11434) and llama.cpp (8081) on localhost. First account you create becomes admin.

apps.name: ComfyUI
apps.description: Node-based Stable Diffusion / Flux image and video generation. GPU accelerated.
apps.compose:
services:
  comfyui:
    image: yanwk/comfyui-boot:cu126-slim
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8188"
    environment:
      CLI_ARGS: "--listen 0.0.0.0"
      TZ: ${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/root:/root
apps.notes: Container images are vendor specific: pick NVIDIA or AMD in the GPU option. First start downloads several GB.

apps.name: n8n
apps.description: Workflow automation with AI agent nodes. Connect Ollama at http://host.docker.internal:11434.
apps.compose:
services:
  n8n:
    image: docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:5678"
    environment:
      N8N_SECURE_COOKIE: "false"
      N8N_HOST: ${HOST_IP}
      WEBHOOK_URL: http://${HOST_IP}:${APP_PORT}/
      GENERIC_TIMEZONE: ${TZ}
      TZ: ${TZ}
      N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY: ${N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/n8n:/home/node/.n8n
    extra_hosts:
      - host.docker.internal:host-gateway

apps.name: Flowise
apps.description: Drag-and-drop LLM apps, agents and RAG pipelines.
apps.compose:
services:
  flowise:
    image: flowiseai/flowise:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
    environment:
      PORT: "3000"
      DATABASE_PATH: /root/.flowise
      SECRETKEY_PATH: /root/.flowise
      LOG_PATH: /root/.flowise/logs
      BLOB_STORAGE_PATH: /root/.flowise/storage
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/flowise:/root/.flowise
    extra_hosts:
      - host.docker.internal:host-gateway

apps.name: AnythingLLM
apps.description: All-in-one private ChatGPT with document chat (RAG) and agents.
apps.compose:
services:
  anythingllm:
    image: mintplexlabs/anythingllm:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    cap_add:
      - SYS_ADMIN
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3001"
    environment:
      STORAGE_DIR: /app/server/storage
      LLM_PROVIDER: ollama
      OLLAMA_BASE_PATH: http://host.docker.internal:11434
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/storage:/app/server/storage
    extra_hosts:
      - host.docker.internal:host-gateway

apps.name: Hermes Agent
apps.description: Nous Research's self-improving AI agent (memory, skills, Telegram/Discord gateway) with web dashboard.
apps.compose:
services:
  hermes:
    image: nousresearch/hermes-agent:latest
    container_name: hermes-agent
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: gateway run
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:9119"
      - "8642:8642"
    environment:
      HERMES_DASHBOARD: "1"
      HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME: admin
      HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD: ${DASHBOARD_PASSWORD}
      TZ: ${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/hermes:/opt/data
    extra_hosts:
      - host.docker.internal:host-gateway
apps.notes: Dashboard login: admin / the DASHBOARD_PASSWORD in Settings > App secrets. Configure a model by running 'docker exec -it hermes-agent hermes setup' in the Terminal tab. For a local model use the Ollama URL http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1.

apps.name: OpenClaw
apps.description: Open-source personal AI assistant gateway (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, browser control).
apps.compose:
services:
  openclaw-gateway:
    image: ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:latest
    container_name: openclaw
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["node", "dist/index.js", "gateway", "--bind", "lan", "--port", "18789"]
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:18789"
    environment:
      OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN: ${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN}
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${OPENAI_API_KEY}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}
      TZ: ${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/state:/home/node/.openclaw
    extra_hosts:
      - host.docker.internal:host-gateway
apps.notes: Gateway token is in Settings > App secrets. Run onboarding once from the Terminal tab: docker exec -it openclaw node dist/index.js onboard

apps.name: SearXNG
apps.description: Private meta search engine. Great as web search for Open WebUI and agents.
apps.compose:
services:
  searxng:
    image: searxng/searxng:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8080"
    environment:
      SEARXNG_BASE_URL: http://${HOST_IP}:${APP_PORT}/
      SEARXNG_SECRET: ${SEARXNG_SECRET}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/config:/etc/searxng

apps.name: Qdrant
apps.description: Vector database for RAG and semantic search (dashboard at /dashboard).
apps.compose:
services:
  qdrant:
    image: qdrant/qdrant:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:6333"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/storage:/qdrant/storage

apps.name: Immich
apps.description: Self-hosted Google Photos: backup, face recognition, smart search (GPU ML).
apps.compose:
services:
  immich-server:
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:release
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:2283"
    environment:
      DB_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      DB_USERNAME: postgres
      DB_DATABASE_NAME: immich
      DB_HOSTNAME: database
      REDIS_HOSTNAME: redis
      TZ: ${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/library:/data
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - database
  immich-machine-learning:
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-machine-learning:release
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/model-cache:/cache
  redis:
    image: docker.io/valkey/valkey:8-bookworm
    restart: unless-stopped
  database:
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres:14-vectorchord0.4.3-pgvectors0.2.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    shm_size: 128mb
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_DB: immich
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: --data-checksums
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data

apps.name: Jellyfin
apps.description: Media server for movies, TV and music with GPU transcoding.
apps.compose:
services:
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8096"
    environment:
      TZ: ${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/config:/config
      - ${DATA_DIR}/cache:/cache
      - ${DATA_DIR}/media:/media
apps.notes: Put media in /opt/ai-panel/data/jellyfin/media. Enable hardware transcoding in Dashboard > Playback.

apps.name: Nextcloud
apps.description: Your own cloud: files, calendar, contacts, office.
apps.compose:
services:
  nextcloud:
    image: nextcloud:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:80"
    environment:
      MYSQL_HOST: db
      MYSQL_DATABASE: nextcloud
      MYSQL_USER: nextcloud
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      NEXTCLOUD_TRUSTED_DOMAINS: ${HOST_IP} localhost
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/html:/var/www/html
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: mariadb:11
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: --transaction-isolation=READ-COMMITTED
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${DB_ROOT_PASSWORD}
      MYSQL_DATABASE: nextcloud
      MYSQL_USER: nextcloud
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/db:/var/lib/mysql

apps.name: File Browser
apps.description: Web file manager for the panel's app data folder.
apps.compose:
services:
  filebrowser:
    image: filebrowser/filebrowser:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:80"
    volumes:
      - /opt/ai-panel/data:/srv
      - ${DATA_DIR}/database:/database
      - ${DATA_DIR}/config:/config
apps.notes: The first-run admin password is printed in the app logs (Logs button).

apps.name: WordPress
apps.description: The world's most popular website and blog builder (with MariaDB).
apps.compose:
services:
  wordpress:
    image: wordpress:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:80"
    environment:
      WORDPRESS_DB_HOST: db
      WORDPRESS_DB_USER: wordpress
      WORDPRESS_DB_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      WORDPRESS_DB_NAME: wordpress
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/html:/var/www/html
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: mariadb:11
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MARIADB_DATABASE: wordpress
      MARIADB_USER: wordpress
      MARIADB_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${DB_ROOT_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/db:/var/lib/mysql

apps.name: InvoicePlane
apps.description: Invoicing, quotes, clients and payments for small businesses.
apps.compose:
services:
  invoiceplane:
    image: mhzawadi/invoiceplane:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:80"
    environment:
      TZ: ${TZ}
      MYSQL_HOST: db
      MYSQL_USER: invoiceplane
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      MYSQL_DB: invoiceplane
      IP_URL: http://${HOST_IP}:${APP_PORT}
      DISABLE_SETUP: "false"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/uploads:/var/www/html/uploads
      - ${DATA_DIR}/css:/var/www/html/assets/core/css
      - ${DATA_DIR}/views:/var/www/html/application/views
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: mariadb:11
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MARIADB_DATABASE: invoiceplane
      MARIADB_USER: invoiceplane
      MARIADB_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${DB_ROOT_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/db:/var/lib/mysql
apps.notes: Open the app and finish the setup wizard. Database host is 'db', credentials are in Settings > App secrets.

apps.name: Ghost
apps.description: Modern publishing platform for blogs and newsletters.
apps.compose:
services:
  ghost:
    image: ghost:5
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:2368"
    environment:
      url: http://${HOST_IP}:${APP_PORT}
      database__client: mysql
      database__connection__host: db
      database__connection__user: ghost
      database__connection__password: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      database__connection__database: ghost
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/content:/var/lib/ghost/content
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: mysql:8
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${DB_ROOT_PASSWORD}
      MYSQL_DATABASE: ghost
      MYSQL_USER: ghost
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/db:/var/lib/mysql

apps.name: Cloudflare Tunnel
apps.description: Publish apps to the internet with HTTPS through Cloudflare, no port forwarding needed.
apps.compose:
services:
  cloudflared:
    image: cloudflare/cloudflared:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    network_mode: host
    command: tunnel --no-autoupdate run
    environment:
      TUNNEL_TOKEN: ${TUNNEL_TOKEN}

inputs.label: Cloudflare tunnel token
inputs.help: Cloudflare dashboard > Zero Trust > Networks > Tunnels > Create tunnel > Docker. Copy the token after --token.

apps.notes: Uses host networking, so in Cloudflare set each public hostname's service to http://localhost:<app port>, e.g. http://localhost:3000 for Open WebUI.

apps.name: Nginx Proxy Manager
apps.description: Reverse proxy with free Let's Encrypt SSL and a simple UI (uses ports 80/443).
apps.compose:
services:
  npm:
    image: jc21/nginx-proxy-manager:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
      - "${APP_PORT}:81"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/data:/data
      - ${DATA_DIR}/letsencrypt:/etc/letsencrypt
    extra_hosts:
      - host.docker.internal:host-gateway
apps.notes: Set your login on first visit (older versions: admin@example.com / changeme).

apps.name: Vaultwarden
apps.description: Lightweight Bitwarden-compatible password manager.
apps.compose:
services:
  vaultwarden:
    image: vaultwarden/server:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:80"
    environment:
      ADMIN_TOKEN: ${ADMIN_TOKEN}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/data:/data
apps.notes: Browsers only allow the web vault over HTTPS. Put it behind Cloudflare Tunnel or Nginx Proxy Manager.

apps.name: WireGuard (wg-easy)
apps.description: VPN with a web UI: reach your server securely from anywhere.
apps.compose:
services:
  wg-easy:
    image: ghcr.io/wg-easy/wg-easy:15
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "51820:51820/udp"
      - "${APP_PORT}:51821/tcp"
    environment:
      INSECURE: "true"
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
      - SYS_MODULE
    sysctls:
      - net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
      - net.ipv4.conf.all.src_valid_mark=1
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/config:/etc/wireguard
      - /lib/modules:/lib/modules:ro
apps.notes: Forward UDP 51820 on your router to this server.

apps.name: Portainer
apps.description: Full Docker management UI (containers, images, volumes, stacks).
apps.compose:
services:
  portainer:
    image: portainer/portainer-ce:lts
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:9443"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - ${DATA_DIR}/data:/data
apps.notes: Create the admin user within 5 minutes of first start, or restart the app.

apps.name: Watchtower
apps.description: Automatically updates all running containers every night at 4 AM and removes old images.
apps.compose:
services:
  watchtower:
    image: nickfedor/watchtower:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      WATCHTOWER_CLEANUP: "true"
      WATCHTOWER_SCHEDULE: "0 0 4 * * *"
      TZ: ${TZ}
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
apps.notes: Maintained fork of containrrr/watchtower (the original was archived and breaks on Docker 29).

apps.name: Dozzle
apps.description: Live log viewer for every container.
apps.compose:
services:
  dozzle:
    image: amir20/dozzle:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8080"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro

apps.name: Uptime Kuma
apps.description: Uptime monitoring with alerts (Telegram, Discord, email...).
apps.compose:
services:
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:2
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3001"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/data:/app/data

apps.name: Netdata
apps.description: Real-time server monitoring with thousands of metrics.
apps.compose:
services:
  netdata:
    image: netdata/netdata:stable
    restart: unless-stopped
    pid: host
    network_mode: host
    cap_add:
      - SYS_PTRACE
      - SYS_ADMIN
    security_opt:
      - apparmor:unconfined
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/config:/etc/netdata
      - ${DATA_DIR}/lib:/var/lib/netdata
      - ${DATA_DIR}/cache:/var/cache/netdata
      - /:/host/root:ro,rslave
      - /etc/passwd:/host/etc/passwd:ro
      - /etc/group:/host/etc/group:ro
      - /etc/os-release:/host/etc/os-release:ro
      - /proc:/host/proc:ro
      - /sys:/host/sys:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
apps.notes: Listens on port 19999 on the host network.

apps.name: VS Code (code-server)
apps.description: VS Code in the browser.
apps.compose:
services:
  code-server:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/code-server:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8443"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: ${TZ}
      PASSWORD: ${PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/config:/config
apps.notes: Password is in Settings > App secrets.

apps.name: Gitea
apps.description: Lightweight self-hosted Git service (SSH on port 2222).
apps.compose:
services:
  gitea:
    image: gitea/gitea:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
      - "2222:22"
    environment:
      USER_UID: "1000"
      USER_GID: "1000"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/data:/data

apps.name: Home Assistant
apps.description: Smart home automation hub.
apps.compose:
services:
  homeassistant:
    image: ghcr.io/home-assistant/home-assistant:stable
    restart: unless-stopped
    network_mode: host
    privileged: true
    environment:
      TZ: ${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/config:/config
      - /run/dbus:/run/dbus:ro
